about.p1: Born and raised in Yaoundé, I work here today as a software developer. I earned a DUT (two-year university diploma) in computer engineering at the IUT of Ngaoundéré, with honours, then a professional bachelor's degree in software engineering at the University Institute of Sciences, Technologies and Ethics (IUSTE), with highest honours, graduating first in my class.
about.p2: In 2024, I joined BkSquare SARL as a research intern to design a facial-recognition system. The project was validated and adopted in-house, and the company hired me at the end of the internship. I now work there as a developer and IT manager. My goal is to pursue an engineering degree or a master's programme to deepen my work in software engineering, information systems and industrial R&D.
about.p3: Alongside this, I have been involved in several community initiatives: coordinating IT communities in the Adamaoua and Far North regions from 2023 to 2024, chairing the IUT Ngaoundéré computer club in 2021–2022, and giving private tutoring in mathematics and computer science. These experiences strengthened my communication, teaching and teamwork skills.
